attempt: Use the imagegen output dimensions directly for a new Hytale tree atlas after requesting 2048x1024 in the prompt.
reason_failed: The generated file was actually 1774x887. Blockbench's Hytale validator rejected the first runtime model for invalid texture dimensions, even though the editor preview rendered. Exact pixel dimensions in a generation prompt are not a native asset contract.
environment: Blockbench MCP 1.7.0, hytale_prop; installed Hytale 0.7.2; built-in image_gen.imagegen; Windows
error_signature: Texture atlas has invalid dimensions (1774x887). Expected width 32 and height multiple of 32.
conditions: Single generated RGBA bark and maple cutout atlas
Editor rendering alone did not reject the image dimensions
workaround: Archive generated source; use native canvas nearest-neighbor normalization to 2048x1024 with alpha preserved, then regenerate UVs from actual dimensions. Keep separate 128x64 held-item texture and 64x64 icons. Twelve individual native models passed validation afterward. Perform the native dimension gate before multiplying variants.

source_refs.description: Generated source dimensions, validator rejection, conversion and final validation evidence
